audits.cleanReason: Every negation token in v2-r4.md was swept (about 45 sentences). Most are plain factual negatives with no positive pivot ('Men who had never drawn a bow', 'managed neither', 'without a ripple', 'No seal, no escort, no letter.' answering a direct question). Fourteen had a contrast or pivot shape and were run through the decision procedure. All fourteen survive. 'a stream she could hear and not see' is spatial precision (condition 2). 'nothing else in the hollow had reason to keep that still' is the binary she acts on, wind or a hiding troll (condition 1). 'At a gallop she couldn't hear one.' and 'she couldn't hear anything wrong in it' are hard perceptual limits that drive the cell beat (condition 3). 'Nothing on the road last night had come near cold enough for that.' turns the frost-nip into a clue (condition 3). 'No. It was real.' (L69), 'No, nonsense.' (L153), 'No. Hold her for a magister' (L283), the L107 run 'None of it was hers... It hadn't. One stone with a limp in it wasn't an army.', and 'She wasn't going to.' (L285) are all Sylvanas arguing with herself in free indirect thought, and the next beat undercuts each one (condition 4). None is a narrator caption. 'she didn't run when they came up on her' is the spy-or-not diagnostic that Sylvanas reasons from at L207 (condition 1). 'Frightened people looked at the door. This one was looking at Sylvanas' is an implicit contrast that reads fear against anger, which is how she judges the prisoner (condition 1). No Not-X-Y fragment pivots, source swaps, count resets, or mundane reveal chains remain. No permission-tag or claim-then-gloss replacement traps were found.

audits.secondSweep: Dedicated P5/P6 second sweep done over every sentence. It looked for inanimate or abstract subjects with agency, desire, cognition, combustion, or physical-behavior verbs, actor demotion into instrument phrases, body-part subjects, abstract states settling into body parts, and metaphor chains. Results: geography verbs ('the slope fell away', 'the track bent', 'the track ran east', 'the southern track... climbing') are stock topographic idiom, not intent. The stone/hum/beat verbs ('hitched', 'came through wrong', 'caught itself', 'the stone had put it') describe the chapter's literal ward phenomenon (subject-matter defense). The horse-gait chain ('favouring a leg' L63, 'a limp in it' L107, 'a limp in the hum' L177, 'The whole ring could be limping' L283) is Sylvanas's own horsewoman vocabulary standing in for the magister word she lacks, which is the planned point of Beat 2, so it is POV voice on the in-world subject and not an intent smear on a noun. Body-part subjects: 'Sylvanas's right hand had closed again. She opened it.' is involuntary and the involuntariness is the point (P8 exception). 'The jaw clamped' is an observed tension state, not a find/know/carry volition. 'her palm could only just reach' uses the palm as the literal sensing surface. No abstract-state-settles-into-body constructions. The second sweep found one new kill: 'more of them than the hour called for' (L195).
